title: Minecraft Ghast
blurb: C418 recorded his own cat while it slept, pitched the result around, and accidentally produced one of the most haunting noises in gaming. Drifting across the Nether, the Ghast's cry means fireballs are already inbound from something enormous, floating, and well out of reach of your sword. The distance is what makes it work: you hear it long before you can do anything about it, which is a rare trick for a game built out of cubes. Cute origin story, genuinely upsetting result — ideal for the feeling of being watched by something that has already made up its mind.
origin: The Ghast cry from Minecraft's Nether — originally recorded from a cat.
